# @three-ws/names

> ENS + SNS name resolution, *.threews.sol subdomain minting, and pay-by-name in one import. The three.ws agent-identity SDK.

@three-ws/names is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/names`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-names/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-names/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-names/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-names/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
